from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class ProfitRecord(BaseModel):
    """One company's reported 持续经营净利润 value for the reporting period."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name as written in the document")
    security_code: str | None = Field(description="The securities code if present")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period (e.g., '2024年第一季度')")
    line_item_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact label as written (e.g., '持续经营净利润')")
    reported_amount: str | None = Field(description="The amount as it appears in the document, including units")
    numeric_value: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value of the amount in yuan for computation")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim line containing the label and amount")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    profit_records: list[ProfitRecord]
